analysis:
Examined the base text of ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift (lines 620-1556) and the visible patch excerpt. Changes are small: (1) two new calls to GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report(error, modelID:) at the model-load failure path (head ~577) and the stream-start failure catch (head ~1023); (2) the pre-content deadline check and first-output timestamp switch from v2UsageSignal.firstWithheldReasoningAt to firstWithheldOutputAt (head ~1147-1149, 1218-1219); (3) a one-line change near head 1325 whose content is truncated in the excerpt.

Security-relevant observations: the new report() calls receive the raw Error, which at the stream-start site may contain rich text (String(describing:)) that can carry prompt content (the surrounding comment says only the normalized reason goes on the wire). The implementation of GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice is not supplied, so I cannot confirm it logs only a fixed, content-free notice. A leak of prompt text in logs would relate to A-001 and T-008/T-041 style disclosure; this is an unverified contract, not a demonstrated issue. The wire path is unchanged: the failure sent to the coordinator still goes through sanitizedInferenceFailure and CapacityRejectionEnrichment. Encryption fail-closed behavior (emitSSE, precomputeSharedKey), the cancel paths and billing floors are untouched in the visible base. The firstWithheldOutputAt rename depends on the EngineV2RequestUsageSignal definition, which is not supplied. Its semantics (withheld answer text counted as generated output for the deadline and TTFT) affect only timing and billing, not confidentiality, but the definition should be checked. The patch excerpt is truncated, and the head text was not supplied, so the remaining changes at head ~1325 cannot be verified.

Next pass should verify: GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report only emits content-free output; the semantics of firstWithheldOutputAt in EngineV2RequestUsageSignal; and that no new plaintext reaches logs or the wire.
